name: Silence Remover
description: Cuts the silences out of the active sequence. The mix is measured in 10 ms windows (sequence.removeSilence), the quiet/loud threshold comes from the recording's own noise floor, and the quiet stretches are ripple-deleted on every unlocked track. No transcript or speech model is needed. One undo step.
author: FilmCraft

entries.label: Couper les silences
entries.description: Silences of 0.5 s or more are cut, keeping 0.1 s of air next to the speech.

entries.label: Couper les silences (serré)
entries.description: Silences of 0.25 s or more are cut, keeping 0.05 s of air.

entries.label: Couper les silences (doux)
entries.description: Only pauses of 1 s or more are cut, keeping 0.2 s of air.
